athlete.ftpNote: Athlete-reported FTP (290W), superseding the earlier Strava-derived estimate of 255W from Jul 2026 Zwift group rides. Use this to set indoor trainer zones directly; worth re-testing again mid-off-season and once more heading into the IM build to catch fitness gains.
athlete.runThresholdNote: Estimated from hard 20-40min efforts at HR 155-166 (Jun-Sep 2026), incl. a 4:14/km sprint-tri finishing run.
athlete.swimNote: Estimated from tracked open-water/pool swims Jun-Aug 2026 (avg HR 100-120, i.e. aerobic, not max effort) — this is the single biggest improvement opportunity in the whole plan.

races.name: IRONMAN 70.3 New York (Long Island)
races.note: Date estimated (pattern: Sep 20 2025, Sep 26 2026) — confirm once IRONMAN releases the 2027 calendar.

meta.fallbackNote: IRONMAN Maryland (Cambridge, MD) — confirmed Saturday, Sept 18, 2027 — is the named fallback if Lake Placid entry falls through, but note it sits 8 weeks AFTER Lake Placid, not on the same date. If Maryland becomes the primary goal instead of a true fallback, the IM-specific build and peak phases below simply slide back by ~8 weeks; the off-season swim block and general aerobic build stay the same length.
meta.schedulingNote: Runs and rides are always scheduled as morning sessions — evening bike/run work disrupts sleep. Swims are flexible and can land in the morning or evening depending on pool access. Weekday cycling is consolidated onto Tuesday and Thursday mornings (stacked with that day's run+strength, brick-style) rather than spread across Mon/Wed/Thu.
